text:
Buffalo comes in on the second night of a back-to-back, still stinging from an 8-3 home loss to Tampa Bay last night, without Konsta Helenius, Justin Danforth and Matt Grzelcyk. Chicago has been idle since a 9-2 loss at Carolina five days ago and is winless in six (0-5-1), without Bowen Byram. Patrick Kane has been cleared from the injury report and is a name to watch. With Byram out, Wyatt Kaiser has moved up to 21:08 a night and Ian Cole to 19:35.

The Blackhawks' record may understate them in one way: their goal difference is far worse than their chances suggest, because finishing and goaltending have cost them. Still, they've had only 41% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five, against 51% for Buffalo. Our model has Buffalo at 3.26 expected goals tonight and Chicago at 2.94. Spencer Knight is the projected Chicago goalie. He's at .881 this season and 2.05 goals below expected, after a strong 11.11 above expected last year. Buffalo's goalie isn't confirmed. The Sabres take more than four penalties a game, though Chicago's power play is modest.

Tage Thompson is our top Sabres scoring pick at 41%, and he's one assist from 200. Jack Quinn is 30%. For Chicago, Roman Kantserov is on an eight-game point streak and is 57% for a point, while Connor Bedard is 36% to score. Our under-the-radar picks are Buffalo's Jason Zucker, whose third-line shots have been dangerous lately (26% to score), and Kantserov.
